notes.title: Update to version 1.4.6
notes.notes:
Added invincibility mode.
It detracts from the appeal of the game.
Please use this mode only if you are unable to clear the game using EASY mode.

*Fixed a delay problem when using a wireless controller.

notes.title: Update Release of Ver 1.1.1
notes.notes:
We apologize for the inconvenience.
We have updated to version 1.1.1 today.

≪Updated content≫
-Add a tutorial.
-Changes to the battle system.
-Adjust enemy defense, strength, speed, and number.
-Decrease in overall difficulty.
-Strengthen EASY mode.
-Add a gallery.
-Easing of gallery release conditions.
-Fixed a bug that occurred when falling.
-Fixed JUTSU and stage selection bugs that could not be used.

≪Future Plans≫
-Bug fixes, screenshot support.
-Add a gallery.
-Added game over illustrations.

Please review and rate the store page if you like.
The more motivated you are, the more galleries you will have.

notes.title: Progress Report 3
notes.notes:
We have finished making adjustments to the attack system and are now working on the tutorial.
Just following the instructions is boring, so I made a system where the women around you take off their clothes as you go through the tutorial.
The feel of the game has been improved, and it's definitely more interesting.
I think I'll be able to report an update next, so please be patient.

notes.title: Progress report 2
notes.notes:
I made it so that you can defeat the enemies by hitting buttons just like in other action games.
Only some strong enemies and bosses will guard, and weak enemies will only guard your jump attack.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YAnF8y1SarE
Based on this system, we will make adjustments to the enemies and then produce a tutorial.
I'm sorry to keep you waiting.
It will take some more time to adjust.

notes.title: Progress report
notes.notes:
Currently, the following adjustments are being made for each difficulty level, and STAGE 5-1 has been completed.
・ Reduce the number of enemies.
・ Weakening of the enemy
(Reduced defense power, reduced attack power, speed down)
・ Increase the number of places where you cannot proceed without defeating the enemy.
・ Increase in items.
・ Increased save points.
・ Eliminate First time players will die.
・ Bug fixes.
At the same time, we are changing the attack system, adding a gallery, and preparing a tutorial.
Please wait a moment now.
